entities.name: Wurm
entities.description: A creature type for large limbless terrestrial reptiles, mostly green-aligned forest dwellers that are preternaturally hungry.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: The Dominarian war in which defeated Elder Dragons were stripped of power, limbs and wings, becoming land wurms.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: Vastly powerful dragons defeated in the Elder Dragon War and turned into land wurms.

entities.name: Rhindle
entities.description: A very large scaled wurm that terrorized Kjeldor in the last decades of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Under Ixidor's Nightmare spell she regurgitated beetles that became deathwurms; Jeska chose to absorb them back.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Cast the Nightmare spell that made Phage's deathwurms, and was devoured when his unmen betrayed him.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angel sent by Ixidor to battle the deathwurms, who could not stop them.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Realized she had to absorb the wurms back into herself, becoming Phage again.

entities.name: Deathwurms
entities.description: Enormous wurms embodying each of Phage's murders.

entities.name: Johtull Wurm
entities.description: Huge armored wurms of the Ice Age that prey on southern Terisiare.

entities.name: Zilgeth
entities.description: Of Clan Ruby, killed by a Johtull Wurm.

events.summary: Under Ixidor's Nightmare spell, Phage regurgitates beetles that become enormous deathwurms embodying her murders.
events.quote: These deathwurms were the embodiment of each of her murders.

events.summary: Ixidor sends Akroma to fight the deathwurms but even the angel cannot stop them.
events.quote: Ixidor sent Akroma to battle them but not even the angel was able to stop them.

events.summary: Ixidor flees with his unmen but some betray him and he is devoured.
events.quote: some of them betrayed him and he was devoured

events.summary: Jeska decides to absorb the wurms back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again.
events.quote: realized that she had to absorb them back in herself, even though that meant she would become Phage again

relations.note: his Nightmare spell produced her deathwurms
relations.quote: Under the Nightmare spell of Ixidor , Phage 's unique constitution made it so that she regurgitated a swarm of beetles

relations.note: sent her to battle the deathwurms
